notes.author: codex-audit
notes.text: 2026-05-29 hands-on lifecycle note: exercised built pm-slack hook without real Slack secrets. Missing PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK produced a clear disabled notification log and did not interrupt the underlying command path. Mocked create event with priority 1 posted JSON containing the expected item title and mrkdwn flag to a fake HTTPS responder; webhook path was redacted in audit output. Mocked close event with HTTP 500 logged Failed to send Slack notification and still returned without throwing. No real customer payloads or secret values were used or printed.

notes.author: codex
notes.text: Added hooks.afterCommand (posts on item create/close when PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK set; silent no-op + never throws/blocks otherwise) and 'pm slack notify' command with rich Slack Block Kit (header+fields+context) and plain-text fallback. Flags --channel/--thread/--on/--text/--title/--dry-run. Manifest capabilities -> commands,hooks,schema. Verified build+tsc+2/2 tests+functional: extension active 0 failures; notify --dry-run emits well-formed Block Kit; afterCommand graceful 'webhook not set — disabled' on close. Backward compatible.

comments.author: codex
comments.text: Feature 1 (events): EventKind expanded to create/close/block/cancel/open/start/unblock/reopen with EVENT_ALIASES (canceled/in_progress/reopened/...); detectEvent derives event from --status option or result-item status via statusToEvent(); lifecycle aliases (claim/start-task=start, pause-task/release/reopen/publish=open) mapped; unblock/reopen refined from previousStatus when pm exposes it. EVENT_META + eventReason (cancel reads close_reason) extended.

comments.author: codex
comments.text: Feature 2 (mentions): PM_SLACK_ASSIGNEE_MAP='name=id,...' parsed by parseAssigneeMap (case-insensitive); resolveAssigneeMention wraps raw id as <@id>, passes <!subteam^..> through; auto-enabled in hook when map non-empty, PM_SLACK_MENTION_ASSIGNEE=0 disables; --assignee/--mention-assignee flags on notify+test. Mention shown in text + blockkit fields.

comments.author: codex
comments.text: Feature 3 (buttons): resolveItemUrl reads github_url/html_url/url/source_url/link (+camelCase), first valid http(s) wins; isGithub detection; buildItemBlockKit appends an actions block with a url-button ('View on GitHub'/'Open item'); plain-text path unchanged; --url flag on notify+test.

comments.author: codex
comments.text: Functional test (real data, scratch /tmp/sltest, pm install --project): live hook via local HTTPS capture confirmed created/opened(draft->open)/started/blocked/canceled events detected+posted; create payload carried Assignee <@U0ALICE1> from PM_SLACK_ASSIGNEE_MAP; cancel reason 'Descoped for Q3' from close_reason; PM_SLACK_ROUTES routed cancel to #descoped. Known limitation: pm 2026.5.31 afterCommand result has no previousStatus, so unblock/reopen surface as 'open' live (refinement is forward-compatible + unit-tested).
